comparison.objective: Inspect opaque cases and return an instrument module only to the empty case, reclosing all lids.
comparison.physical_skill: Open-and-inspect sequencing while carrying and placing a module.
comparison.success_condition: Module enters the vacant case, occupied cases are not used, and all lids finish seated. Numeric placement tolerances are not stated.
comparison.reason: The central ability is visual occupancy inference followed by case placement, not controlled impact fracture or loose-fragment recovery.
